subject: Strategic HC redistribution & temporary backfill approval
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Greenfield Recruiting <recruiting@greenfield.co>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: strategic HC redistribution & temporary backfill

Hi Marissa / Vivek,

Quick summary: Rohan Mehta (Sr. Infra Engineer, team: Serving Runtime) gave notice today; last day 2/28. He owns low-level kernel work and the KV-cache optimizations that are on the critical path for our Q2 perf milestone. Given hiring freeze constraints and our commitment to the Q2 roadmap, I’m proposing a temporary 90-day contractor backfill + a one-time HC redistribution (move 1 open backend IC slot from ML infra to Serving Runtime for the quarter).

Why this instead of a permanent hire now:
- Freeze prevents immediate new req approvals except for strategic exceptions.
- Temporary contractor lets us keep momentum without committing long-term HC.
- The ML infra slot is a lower-priority hire this quarter (postponable by one quarter).

Requesting:
1) Approval for a 90-day freeze exception to move 1 open backend IC slot (ML infra -> Serving Runtime)
2) Approval to engage Greenfield Recruiting to source a contractor (rate cap $165/hr, 40 hrs/week)

Attachments: temporary-backfill-MAP.xlsx (brief MER, ramp plan, cost estimate)

If you approve in principle I’ll loop Mina (People Ops) to file the exception form and route to finance for the temporary cost center. Greenfield is on standby and can present SOW within 24 hours.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Staff Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: temporary-backfill-MAP.xlsx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Greenfield Recruiting <recruiting@greenfield.co>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: strategic HC redistribution & temporary backfill

Jordan — thanks for the heads up and for the clear ask.

I’m supportive of a temporary redistribution provided we get: duration, cost cap, and a clear rollback plan so ML infra’s slot is returned next quarter. Two quick clarifying Qs:
- Can we confirm expected contractor start date (earliest feasible) and ramp milestones?
- Is $165/hr total all-in (including vendor fees)?

Looping Mina for formal exception paperwork and to confirm org-impact before I sign off.

Marissa
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2027 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: strategic HC redistribution & temporary backfill

Thanks for including me — I can own the exception workflow but need the following before I can submit to finance/people ops:
1) Completed headcount-exception form (link below)
2) Short org chart showing where the slot moves from/to (1 slide)
3) Estimated duration and cost (break out hourly vs vendor fees) + vendor SOW (sample ok)

I’ve attached the backfill MAP template (contractor ramp, KPIs, handoff plan). Please fill and send back by EOD tomorrow if you want to move fast. Note: approvals typically take 48 hours once I have the packet; expedited for product-critical infra work.

Headcount exception form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/headcount-exception-form

Attachment: contractor-sow-template.pdf; backfill MAP template attached.

Mina Haddad
People Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: contractor-sow-template.pdf]
[Attachment: temporary-backfill-MAP.xlsx]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2027 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: strategic HC redistribution & temporary backfill — APPROVED (90 days)

Approved.

I agree with the rationale — we cannot let the Serving Runtime roadmap slip for a sprint-level dependency. Conditions:
1) 90-day exception only; slot reverts to ML infra at the start of Q3 unless a new permanent req is approved through standard HC cycle.
2) Rate cap $165/hr all-in (vendor fees included). No exceptions without my explicit re-approval.
3) Jordan to own ramp plan and weekly status (add a 10-min update to Ops sync).
4) Mina to route the exception through People Ops + Finance and create a temporary cost center.

Jordan — once you upload the completed form and SOW (use Mina’s template) I’ll confirm sign-off to finance. Good work moving fast on this.

— Vivek
VP, Product & Platform
Redwood Inference
